name: RavenQuest
summary: RavenQuest is a free-to-play, 2.5D pixel-art sandbox MMORPG built on a fully player-driven economy. A Web3 development fork of the successful MMORPG Ravendawn, RavenQuest offers deep customization through a classless system where players combine three different "Archetypes" to create a unique playstyle. The game features a dynamically changing open world where players can claim land, build customized houses, and gather resources through farming, mining, and husbandry. Everything in the game, from weapons to tradepacks, is crafted by players. Whether you prefer cooperative PvE dungeon crawling, exploring the open world for ancient secrets, or participating in high-stakes opt-in PvP (including 2v2 Arenas, Tradepack Plundering, and massive Guild Wars), your legacy shapes the world.
